forgot.intro: The password cannot be recovered from inside the app.
forgot.step1: On the computer running this app, open the following file.

forgot.fileLocationHint: If you cannot find it, right-click the icon you use to start the app and choose “Open file location” to open that folder.

forgot.quitFirst: Close the app before you edit the file. If you edit it while the app is running, the app may write the old value back.
forgot.step2: Inside it, find the line that reads
forgot.step5: Then, in the same file, find the line that starts with
forgot.step6: and delete that line. If it stays, the app will ask you for the old password — the one you forgot — when you try to choose a new one.
forgot.step7: Save the file and start the app again. After that you can choose a new password from the settings screen.
forgot.note: Only someone who can use the computer running this app can do this.
forgot.lanNote: Turning the password off again does not turn off using the app from other devices.

limitations._marker: M19-LIMITATION-NOTICE: If you change this limitation copy, also review/update the BE target-enumeration rule (fastest_unreachable / startup_basis / parent refs), filler rule (exclude target_combo AND is_derived; exclude solo-unavailable moves), composite chain filler units, KA-NULL/negative-KA handling, gap mode, and truncation (internal/service/setplay/service.go), and vice versa.
limitations.title: About suggestion limitations
limitations.frameOnly: Suggestions are derived from frame math only; spacing, opponent body size, and on-hit situation are not evaluated. Always verify in-game.
limitations.notExhaustive: No suggestions does not mean no valid setplay exists.
limitations.outOfScope: Currently out of scope: combos without knockdown advantage / combos with negative knockdown advantage / moves without active frames / moves that cannot reach a grounded opponent even on the fastest solo input / move types turned OFF in the type filter (special (non-projectile), throw, normal (rush), unique (rush)) / zero-damage moves (by default). Later hits of a target combo that require a preceding hit or block, and derived moves that cannot be performed on their own, are not used as standalone fillers. Derived moves whose startup is measured from a parent are suggested with the parent placed in front (the leading parent is not counted toward the frame budget).
limitations.frameCaveatsTitle: Frame-data caveats (based on what the in-game frame meter can show)
limitations.multiHit: Multi-hit moves (e.g. Ryu's Axe Kick) count the gaps between hits — where no hitbox is active — as part of the active window. So an "active frame N" hit may actually land during a gap with no hitbox.
limitations.lingeringProjectile: Lingering projectiles (e.g. Hadoken) treat recovery as active frames, so the frame the projectile actually leaves the screen is not represented.
limitations.lingeringSetup: Lingering setup moves (e.g. Rashid's Arabian Cyclone) treat recovery as active frames, so the frame the placed move actually disappears is not represented.
limitations.stateFiller: Fillers may include moves that require a state (e.g. moves during Denjin charge).
limitations.weakChain: Suggestions that whiff light attacks back to back are calculated assuming chain-cancelling (cancelling the previous light's recovery into the next). Note that some suggestions repeating the same light attack are still calculated without chain-cancelling, in which case the frame budget reads higher than in-game.
limitations.negativeKnockdown: Combos with negative knockdown advantage cannot produce suggestions.
limitations.gapDependsOpponent: "Deliberate gap" suggestions assume the opponent acts, so whether they work depends on the opponent.
limitations.topOnly: When there are many candidates, only the top ones are shown (use "Show more" to load additional).
